data: This course builds upon Analysis 1 and Analysis 2 by helping us generalise our understanding of notions like limits and continuity from sequences of real numbers and functions of a single real variable to more sophisticated contexts. The course begins by developing the theory of sequences of functions, and introduces the important notion of uniform convergence: continuity, differentiability, and integrability are studied in this context. This material is then used to better understand the role that polynomials play in spaces of functions and introduce the important idea of a power series.
